terms.heading: Terms
items: The campaign applies to the first 500 Cleaners who meet the campaign requirements and become approved and activated.
A campaign spot is only finally allocated once MyCleaner has confirmed it. An application or profile creation does not automatically reserve a spot.
The campaign period lasts three consecutive calendar months from the first completed and paid booking.
MyCleaner's standard provider platform fee is 0 during the campaign period.
Payment processing fees, taxes, VAT, insurance and other third-party costs may still apply.
The campaign is valid once per person or business and must not be circumvented by creating multiple profiles.
The offer cannot be combined with other provider discounts or campaigns.
The Cleaner's account must continue to comply with MyCleaner's terms, quality requirements and safety requirements.
MyCleaner does not guarantee a specific number of bookings or specific earnings.
Abuse, fraud or a material breach of the terms may result in loss of the campaign benefit to the extent permitted by applicable law.
MyCleaner may change or end the campaign for future participants. An already confirmed campaign benefit must not be changed retroactively in violation of applicable law.
